description: This file contains utility functions for enriching documents with normalized project IDs and updated timestamps, including functions for normalizing project IDs, parsing dates, computing the latest update timestamp, and enriching deployment-like documents.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string id, accepting strings, numbers, and objects with specific fields.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updated timestamp from a document's fields or its _id.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Enriches a deployment-like document with normalized projectId and updatedAt timestamp.
